methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: covers well-understood fundamental energy management activities common across energy management texts.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Qualitative maturity framework without an identified or characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper proposes and conducts a preliminary evaluation of an Energy Management Maturity Model, meant for energy managers in all kinds of organizations, that organizes the essential energy management activities across five maturity levels

stage1.notes: EnPIs appear only as an activity to establish; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is specified.
